metadata.question: Between January 8 and January 15, 2020, did Sistan-Baluchestan experience over 3 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need precipitation data for Sistan-Baluchestan province in Iran between Jan 8-15, 2020. GPM IMERG is a good source for global precipitation data. 2. Masking strategy: Precipitation data doesn't typically need cloud masking like optical imagery. 3. Logic: Sum precipitation over the period and check if > 3 inches (76.2 mm since 1 inch = 25.4 mm). Steps: - Define geometry for Sistan-Baluchestan province - Get GPM IMERG precipitation data for Jan 8-15, 2020 - Sum precipitation over the period - Convert to mm and check if > 76.2 mm - Handle cases: no data, no valid pixels, calculation failure Need to be careful about: - Checking if collection is empty - Checking if valid pixels exist - Validating the result (should be reasonable precipitation value) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sistanBaluchestan = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Sistan and Baluchestan')); const startDate = '2020-01-08'; const endDate = '2020-01-15'; // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG for precipitation const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(sistanBaluchestan); const precipSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images: ${precipSize}`); if (precipSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sistanBaluchestan, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid precipitation pixels."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation in mm const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sistanBaluchestan, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log(`Total precipitation (mm): ${meanPrecip ? meanPrecip.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || meanPrecip === undefined || isNaN(meanPrecip)) { console.log("C3"); } else { const inches = meanPrecip / 25.4; // Convert mm to inches console.log(`Total precipitation (inches): ${inches.toFixed(2)}`); if (inches > 3) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
